;Armed conflicts and attacks 
*[[Norma Azucena Rodríguez Zamora]], a recently elected member of the [[Congress of Mexico]], is kidnapped by gunmen in the state of [[Hidalgo (state)|Hidalgo]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45195184 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Ponte Morandi collapse]]
**The [[Ponte Morandi]] [[viaduct]] collapses on the [[Autostrada A10 (Italy)|A10 motorway]] in [[Genoa]], [[Italy]]. 38 people are confirmed dead, 16 others are seriously injured, 5 are missing and 632 displaced. 35 cars and three heavy vehicles are involved in the accident. Several homes are also damaged and people inside them also injured. [http://www.tgcom24.mediaset.it/cronaca/liguria/lutto-a-genova-per-il-crollo-del-ponte-almeno-35-le-vittime-3-sono-bambini_3158009-201802a.shtml (TGCom)]
*A road accident in [[Quito]], [[Ecuador]] involving a bus and a truck leaves 24 people dead and 18 others injured. [https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2018/08/14/accidente-de-transito-en-ecuador-deja-decenas-de-muertos-y-varios-heridos/ (CNN en Español)]
*Ten people are killed and another injured in a fire at a care home in [[Chiguayante]], [[Chile]]. [http://www.24horas.cl/nacional/incendio-en-hogar-de-ancianos-de-chiguayante-deja-10-mujeres-fallecidas-2790765 (''24 Horas'')]

;International relations
*Following a period of quiet, [[Israel]] reopens the [[Kerem Shalom]] crossing into [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-45185306 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Grand jury investigation of Catholic Church sexual abuse in Pennsylvania]]
**A [[grand jury]] report alleging that more than 300 priests abused over 1,000 children in six [[Pennsylvania]] Catholic diocese -- [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Allentown|Allentown]], [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Scranton|Scranton]], [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Harrisburg|Harrisburg]], [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Pittsburgh|Pittsburgh]], [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Greensburg|Greensburg]], and [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Erie|Erie]] -- is released by state [[Attorney General of Pennsylvania|Attorney General]] [[Josh Shapiro]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/acts-of-faith/wp/2018/08/14/pennsylvania-grand-jury-report-on-sex-abuse-in-catholic-church-will-list-hundreds-of-accused-predator-priests/?noredirect=on (''Washington Post'')] [https://www.timesleader.com/news/714975/pa-clergy-sex-abuse-report-releasedhttps://www.timesleader.com/news/714975/pa-clergy-sex-abuse-report-released (''Times Leader'')]
*[[2018 Westminster car crash]]
**A man is arrested near the [[Palace of Westminster]] in [[London]] after a [[Ford Fiesta]] hit pedestrians, cyclists and a security barrier. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/08/14/car-crashes-barrier-outside-parliament-armed-police-surround/  (''The Daily Telegraph'')]   
*[[Stand-your-ground law]] in [[Florida]]
**Michael Drejka is charged with [[manslaughter]] by a state attorney after a reversal of an earlier decision made by police. The case stems from a controversial video that shows Drejka shooting another man over a handicapped parking space and claiming self defense. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/nbcblk/michael-drejka-charged-florida-stand-your-ground-killing-why-wasn-n900406 (NBC)]
*[[Capital punishment in Nebraska]]
**[[Nebraska]] executes convicted murderer Carey Dean Moore, becoming the first [[United States|U.S.]] state to execute an inmate with [[fentanyl]], and what is also the state's first execution in 21 years, and its first by [[lethal injection]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-45185687 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**[[Spain]], [[Portugal]], [[France]], [[Germany]] and [[Luxembourg]] agree to take in 141 migrants, 67 of them unaccompanied children, who were rescued on Friday by the [[Aquarius (NGO ship)|MV ''Aquarius'']]; [[Malta]] allows the ship to dock. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/14/aquarius-migrant-rescue-ship-to-be-allowed-dock-in-malta (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Kansas gubernatorial election, 2018]]
**Incumbent [[List of Governors of Kansas|Governor of Kansas]] [[Jeff Colyer]] concedes defeat to [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] challenger [[Kris Kobach]] in the primary election. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/14/politics/kris-kobach-wins-kansas-republican-governor-primary/index.html (CNN)]
